title: hearthmap calibration proposals
description: calibration.json: per-sensor soil calibration ranges proposed by tools/calibrate from history, for review and import in the editor. A sensor's calibration object has exactly the shape of a pin's calibration in hearthmap.schema.json. Field meanings: tools/calibrate/README.md.

generated_at.description: When the proposals were computed, ISO 8601 UTC.

parameters.description: The analysis parameters used, for reproducibility. Informational: importers must not depend on its keys.

entity_id.description: The Home Assistant entity id; matched against pins' entities.moisture on import.

status.description: ok: calibration present. Every other status: cannot calibrate, message says why.

calibration.description: Same shape and units as a pin's calibration. happy_min/happy_max are always present and are defaults unless happy_is_default is false.

happy_is_default.description: True: happy_min/happy_max are the tool's stated fraction of the range (parameters), not species knowledge. Tune per species.

polarity.description: normal: higher reading is wetter. inverted: higher is drier (dry > wet in calibration). null when no range was computed far enough to decide.

drying_rate_per_day.description: Raw units per day in the drying direction (always positive), or null if no drying trend was seen.

evidence.description: Counts and intermediate values behind the proposal (samples, unavailable, impossible, outliers, flatlined, history_days, methods, percentiles). Informational.
